exposure: maneuvers to relieve pressure on the umbilical cord
cohort: The study included 24 cases of cord prolapse, excluding cord presentations, over a period of 30 months.
finding: The study showed satisfactory neonatal outcomes with no perinatal mortalities noted, suggesting that diagnosis to delivery interval (DDI) could be a critical determinant.
mod_finding: Except for one vaginal delivery, all women underwent crash cesarean section delivery, contributing to satisfactory neonatal outcomes.
